facts.business: MMTC Limited is a Government of India enterprise that was the largest trading company in India, but has not undertaken any business activities since April 2022 per Ministry of Commerce & Industry direction, and currently only earns interest and dividend income from investments.

auditor.name: Dinesh Jain & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-recognition of provision of Rs.82.82 crore in Anglo Coal case; Material uncertainty related to going concern as Government is yet to decide exit route for MMTC

key_risks: Anglo Coal case liability of Rs.170.58 crore with only Rs.87.76 crore provided
Material uncertainty related to going concern as Government is yet to decide exit route
CBI investigation into financial irregularities and fraud at MTPL Singapore
No business activities since April 2022 per Ministry direction
Contingent liabilities exceed available cash balance
facts.related_party_note: Dividend income of Rs.26.88 crore received from BSE Ltd (3,50,649 equity shares held); MMTC-PAMP India Pvt. Ltd. is a joint venture company
